news.title: Student Affairs is now Division of Student Success
news.summary_en: The Division of Student Affairs is now the Division of Student Success. The name is new, but the mission is not, said Anna Gonzalez, vice chancellor for student success.

news.title: Flory to depart WashU as vice chancellor for marketing and communications
news.summary_en: Julie Flory, vice chancellor for marketing and communications, has left the university as of Aug. 3, after more than a decade of service, announced Chancellor Andrew D. Martin.
